description: Search and discover available GitHub actions in the 83-action catalog by keyword query or domain filter. Use this discovery tool first whenever you need to perform an action outside the 3 eager daily drivers (e.g. managing PRs, issues, releases, workflows, collaborators, webhooks, variables, security alerts). Returns matching action names, domain categories, mutating flags, descriptions, and parameter signatures so you can construct the call for github_execute_action.

domain.description: Optional domain filter to restrict discovery to a specific functional category

format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, compact human/LLM-readable text table) or 'json' (structured object with parameter schemas)

query.description: Search keyword query to match against action names, domains, or descriptions (e.g. 'pull request', 'issue comment', 'webhook', 'deploy', 'dependabot')

name: github_find_actions
title: Find GitHub Actions
